lines: Mindset can *make or break* your sales.
body: 5 mindset traps, and how to beat them.
Set goals, ask for feedback, and treat every obstacle as a chance to improve.
Every "no" is a lesson. Focus on the value you bring to the customer.
Talk to yourself like a coach. Focus on your strengths and your wins.
Listen actively. Understand the customer's side. Care about their success.
Build long-term relationships based on trust and mutual respect.
Go deeper in the book Do Epic Sales by Zuber Palawkar.
